summary: Regression test after code-quality refactors (algorithm.aggregate helpers, get_current_user helpers, AuthContext useMemo). Ran full backend pytest suite: 27/27 passed (all 5 aggregate scenarios, auth/logout/register, RBAC admin CRUD on /api/admin/allergens, per-user report isolation, allergens count=282). Frontend UI regression on public URL: admin login->workspace, allergen selection (Tutti + Aggiungi selezionati -> 282 items in right panel), tab switching Nuovo/Storico/Configurazione (admin-only visible), preview button enabled, logout returns to login form. No React warnings, no render loops, no page exceptions in console.
critical_code_review_comments: Refactors are clean: aggregate() delegates to small helpers with unchanged behavior confirmed by 5 scenario tests.
get_current_user() now cleanly splits JWT vs Emergent-session paths; 401 for unauth still returned correctly.
AuthContext value memoized correctly via useMemo; deps include user, loading, login, logout, register, refreshMe — no stale closures observed.
seed_data_creation: None persistent. Test users test_user_*@example.com and test_*@example.com created during tests; zTEST_ allergens created and deleted within CRUD test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests cover: auth (login/register/logout/me/google/refresh), allergens listing (282), aggregate 5 scenarios, reports CRUD, admin RBAC + CRUD, per-user isolation. Frontend admin flow validated via Playwright on REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Data-testid used: login-email-input, login-password-input, login-submit-button, btn-preview-report-button, logout-button. Tab buttons use text ('Nuovo Report','Storico','Configurazione'). AuthContext memo change did not introduce any regression.
